app/src/lib/api.ts:33 — isBuildStep() env-var guard, repeated in all six handlers ((home).ts:12, pokemon/[name].ts:111, moves/[name].ts:11, abilities/[name].ts:11, types/[name].ts:11), works around undocumented build-time handler invocation
app/src/document.ts:16 — CSS hrefs via new URL(..., import.meta.url).pathname instead of the documented /src/... href Vite rewrites
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access, formatting, and rendering are each isolated behind one module, and the framework surface is confined to thin route definitions — an upgrade would touch few files. The deductions are the POKEDEX_BUILD_STEP workaround, which couples six handlers to an undocumented build behavior with no documented alternative in ModuleOptions, and the import.meta.url-derived stylesheet paths, which depend on bundler implementation details rather than the documented asset-href pattern.

findings.issue: isBuildStep() relies on a custom POKEDEX_BUILD_STEP env var (set in vite.config.ts:6) to detect Gracile's undocumented build-time handler invocation, and the guard is duplicated in all six route handlers
findings.suggestion: Track Gracile's ModuleOptions (route.d.ts exposes prerender/staticPaths) for a first-class build/context flag and migrate when it appears; in the meantime at least keep the guard out of individual handlers by neutralizing it inside lib/api.ts's getJson/mustGetJson and having handlers tolerate empty data

findings.issue: @lit-labs/ssr and @lit-labs/ssr-client are direct dependencies but never imported by app source; both ship transitively with @gracile/gracile 0.11.0
findings.suggestion: Remove both; re-declare only if the app later adopts Lit custom elements or hydration

findings.issue: Stylesheet hrefs computed as new URL('./styles/tokens.css', import.meta.url).pathname, deviating from the documented '/src/styles/...' href that Vite rewrites during build; couples the page to server-bundle path layout and the static middleware
findings.suggestion: Use the documented source-relative href (e.g. /src/styles/tokens.css) and let Vite emit the hashed asset, or import the CSS explicitly if a future Gracile supports it

findings.issue: In-flight species-index/page fetches are never aborted; staleness is handled by a hand-rolled ticket counter (same pattern in pokemon/[name].client.ts:40)
findings.suggestion: Pass an AbortController signal to fetch and abort the previous request on new input; keeps the ticket check as a belt-and-braces

findings.issue: Game switching fetches the whole page and DOMParser-extracts [data-move-tables], coupling the client script to rendered markup structure rather than a data endpoint
findings.suggestion: Consider a JSON endpoint (like /api/species-index) for move tables, or accept the coupling knowingly since it degrades gracefully via location.assign

summary: This app is built squarely on the current Gracile 0.11 generation — its route contract, server endpoints, node adapter, and document html tag all match the framework's published types, docs, and official starter, with lit 3.3.3, express 5, vite 8, and TS 7 keeping the whole stack current. Architecture is churn-resistant where it counts: one fetch/cache module, typed view models, and templates shared between SSR and client so outputs can't drift. The main risks are the undocumented POKEDEX_BUILD_STEP build-detection workaround and import.meta.url-derived stylesheet paths, plus two unused @lit-labs deps and missing AbortController usage.
